tool_args.rationale: All eight observations lie close to a proportional response of approximately 1.75 times current input. An affine fit allows small initial-state and horizon corrections, with parameters estimated numerically; fresh confirmation will test its predictive adequacy.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The long-horizon observations are nearly linear in current input; the available horizon range does not identify a relaxation rate reliably.
The acquired batch already supports a low-complexity long-horizon approximation; fresh confirmation is more informative than repeating the probe.
It does not address the remaining model uncertainty.
